findings.candidate_quote: However, direct drug-mediated effects on fecal communities were not observed in in vitro experiments.
findings.reference_quote: High concentrations of TAC and CSA, respectively, resulted in altered GM composition compared with 1% DMSO based on PERMANOVA analysis (TAC: p = 0.0220, CSA: p = 0.0010)
findings.explanation: The categorical absence of direct effects contradicts the experimental results. Both drugs altered community composition at high concentrations, although the authors questioned whether those concentrations occur in vivo. The candidate repeats the abstract's simplification without preserving this qualification.
